# Free in-game pack: Beelzebilly suit & head and Mr. Demonic backpack

![Free In-Game Pack: Beelzebilly Suit & Head and Mr. Demonic Backpack](/uploads/513_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This bundle was originally available as a promo package for QuakeCon in 2020. Anyone who played Fallout 76 at the time could get it for free. I've had the package since 2020. But now there is a new way to get the items.

You can currently get this package again **free** from Bethesda. In return, Bethesda would like a **newsletter subscription** from you. You can redeem the whole thing via your Bethesda account. There you should have connected your gaming accounts (Xbox, Steam, PS5) to receive the package.

Get free in-game package

### Free in-game package includes:

- **Beelzebilly Suit**
Get the Beelzebilly Suit to add a demonic vibe to your daily adventures.
- **Beelzebilly Head**
Get the Beelzebilly head and dress up as a very special Sheepsquatch.
- **Mr. Demonic Backpack**
Get the Mr. Demonic Backpack so you can store your items and keep everyone around you on edge.

## This is how you get this package

1. Click on this button: Get free in-game package
2. Now you are on Bethesda.net and log in with your account.
3. Now click the Redeem button and confirm your newsletter subscription. Complete.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-free-ingame-bundle-beelzebilly-de.jpg)
